$comment: VAPP-201 (eApps §4.3) THE TEAM TIME ZONE ×4. `teams.time_zone` = an IANA name out of contract `timeZones.names`, NULL = no team zone: every host reads app dates in the DEVICE's zone (the behaviour before VAPP-201). Synced on the teams shape; written by an OWNER through tRPC `teams.update {timeZone}` (null clears it; a name the triggers' ICU check refuses = BAD_REQUEST) and MCP `teams update {timeZone}`. SETTINGS › GENERAL (web general-section, desktop team_general.rs, iOS TeamSettingsPages, Android team general page): one row `copy.row` in the General group under Name = THE schedule zone picker (the same searchable Picker over contract `timeZones.names` the trigger schedule uses; no new component) whose FIRST item is `copy.device` (value null); the row reads the zone name, or `copy.device` while NULL; owners pick (saved at once, a failure = the failed-action toast), everyone else sees it disabled. testId `testIds.row`. APP HOSTS (web exponential-ui-host, desktop exponential_ui_host.rs, iOS Apps/AppHost.swift, Android ui/apps/AppHost.kt): the eUI host's `zone` (minutes east of UTC at an instant: `today()`, date maths, package actions) = the zone `resolveZone(teamZone)` names when it names one, else the device's (an unknown name never breaks an app). Every platform's tz database must agree on `zoneCases` (TS Intl, Rust jiff, Swift TimeZone(identifier:), Kotlin ZoneId): `zoneOffset(zone, ms)` = `offset` (minutes east). `resolveCases`: `resolveZone(teamZone)` = `zone` (null = the device's). Package `tests` keep UTC.

resolveCases.name: an unknown name falls back to the device
